'''Yannick Lapointe DS''' is the [[Dark]] constructed list [[Yannick Lapointe]] posted on DeckTech. The published title is not used as the page title; it appears in the original post below.<ref name="dt-18147">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/18147 DeckTech post 18147], DeckTech (Yannick "Crusher" Lapointe, 8 August 2001). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/18147/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/18147/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Yannick Lapointe]]
* '''Published:''' 8 August 2001 (DeckTech)
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Tatooine]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Bring Him Before Me / Take Your Father's Place|DS2-D-bringhimbeforeme.gif|label=Bring Him Before Me}}
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' {{CardLink|Prepared Defenses|DS2-D-prepareddefenses.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PTat BHBM Lapointe DS 2001 DeckTech.txt |Download]] (omits grabbler: not in GEMP)
* '''Strategy:''' this deck is a machine

The post also lists 2x grabbler, which matches no known card; it is shown as posted and counted in the published total.
